rows.en: Your opponent is me, the great Ashura!
This is where you'll be buried!
Behold the might of Commander Ranking No. 1!
I'll show you we're in different leagues!
I'll kill you, just as you wish!
I'm a cut above those small fry!
This is the end, Kenryuu!!
Die! Baikanfu!!
Nice of you to get so big! Now none of my shots can miss!
rows.notes: Against a large/combined target (e.g. Baikanfu).

rows.en: Persistent bastard...!
rows.notes: Also used by Grujios; works for both.

rows.en: Coward! You think you can run?!
Now, how should I carve you up...!?
You'll regret standing up to Gyandlar!
Drop dead! Kenryuu!!
Got you now, Baikanfu!!
Damn you! The great Ashura... GAAAAAAH!!
Me?! Commander Ranking No. 1?! Nooooo!!
Lord Gadeeeeees!!
Nngh...! What do you think you're doing?!
B-but I'm the strongest Gyandlar Commander!
Until I offer your head to Lord Gades... I won't fall!!
Y-you! I'll never forgive you!!
Pushing me this far... you're no ordinary foe!!
D-damn these pesky small fry!
B-beaten this badly by the likes of Kenryuu...!!
So this is the greatest power of Cronos...!
GUGAAAAAH!!
How dare you scratch the great Ashura's body!!
Damn iiiit...!!
Your gloating ends right here!!
Now I can't let you get away!!
Hmph, not yet! Don't make me laugh!!
Grr...! Not bad, Kenryuu!!
D-damn you! Baikanfu!!
And THIS is what's been giving Gyandlar so much trouble?!
Gahahahaha! That didn't hurt!!
Is that all?! You must think Gyandlar's a joke!
Going easy on the great Ashura? You're unbelievable!
I trained a lot harder than you lot!
The great Ashura is invincible!!
So this is all Kirai's disciple amounts to!
Tenku Chushin Ken is nothing to fear!!
As if you could ever hit the great Ashura!
What's wrong?!
How impudent!
Fuhahaha! Where are you aiming?!
Too bad!!
Hmph! Your power can't break through my Barrier!
Mere missiles...!
Oh, now this is an interesting device!
Too soft! Way too soft!!
Well? Surprised?!
Whoa?! I'm out of Nattoru Bullets?!
Hmph! Looks like you got lucky this time!
I can't counterattack?!
Where are you?! Too scared of me?!
Persistent bastard! Drop dead!!
Hahahaha! You fell for it!!
The great Ashura has arrived!
Stand back! You're no match for this!
You'll never be able to stop me!
It can't be helped. Leave it to me!
Men, get them!!
Don't let that one escape!!
Hahaha!! You're a rat in a trap now!
Leave it to me!
Eat Nattoru Bullets!!
Take this! Nattoru Bullet!!
Nattoru Bullet, fire!!
Achaaaaaah!!
I'll send you all to hell!
It is all over!
I shall dispose of you all...!
Kukukuku... Yes, hate! Hate all you like...!
rows.notes: Gades feeds on hatred; he is urging the target to hate.

rows.en: Know my power!!
rows.notes: Also used by Vega; works for both.

rows.en: Death... to all who defy Gyandlar!
If not for you lot, it would never have come to this!
Accursed people of Cronos!
I shall not forgive this
I will not fall to small fry like you!
Your wailing is useless...!
Go on, struggle... struggle...!
GUOAAAAAAH!
Wh-what is this?! T-to think I would be beaten...
Wh-what is the meaning of this...!
Impossible! This cannot be! It cannot!
N-no! At this rate...
Guh! I should have killed you long ago...
Kirai's son... to think he'd come this far...!
Nngh! Accursed wretch!
Guoh?! You're quite good
This much will never be enough to defeat me!
You think you've beaten me?! How naive, Rom Stol!!
Rom Stol... Will you defy me to the very end...!
You dare wound my body!
Do not underestimate the great Gades...
A mere small fry's attack, after all...
Is that all?! Some Tenku Chushin Ken that is!!
The guidance of Kenro, you say? With only that...!
And you call that aiming...
Guhahahahahahahaha
Pathetic
Kukuku... Too bad
Cease this futile effort
How can this be?!
You dare humiliate the great Gades!
I shall finish you myself!
You've come all this way. Why run now?
This is the end! I'll send you to hell myself!!
I shall face you personally!
Let me see just what you're made of
Kukukukukuku...
It is all over
How's this?!
Take the full force of my power!!
I won't let you do as you please!
Gades!! You once stole my mind, but I'll waver no more!
rows.notes: Garudi was brainwashed by Gades before turning; 'stole my mind' renders kokoro wo ubawareta.

rows.en: I'll return the favor!
I'll make you regret attacking me!!
So this is the end!
I've been beaten! That was over surprisingly fast...
Rom! I leave the rest to you!!
Gahh!
I can't believe I've taken this much!
At this rate, I'll be beaten!
Guh! I've taken too much damage!!
What?!!
You're pretty good!
rows.notes: Shared with Blue Jet and Elfie; neutral.

rows.en: A direct hit?! I got careless!!
If it's only this much damage...
Ohh!
rows.notes: Shared with the G Gundam fighters; plain interjection.

rows.en: Gnngh!
It only grazed me!
That won't bring me down!
I can't afford to get hit!
I can dodge something like this!
Your aim is sloppy!!
A Barrier, eh? Handy thing to have!
Damn! I slipped up!
At this range... I can't counter!
I'll cover you!!
Sorry, but I can't let you escape!
Careless fool! Now die!!
I won't let that happen!
What are you doing?! Do you want to die?!
I'll handle that one! Rest while you can!
Let's go!
rows.notes: Shared with Ginga, Hokuto and Giga Witter; 'Let's go!' works for all.

rows.en: Tenku Chushin Ken! Rapid-Fire Fist!
Tenku Shin Ken! Nagase Otoshi!!
rows.notes: Nagase is Garudi's sword; attack name romanized (otoshi = drop/fall).
uncertain: Attack name 'Tenku Shin Ken: Nagase Otoshi' not in glossary; romanized as 'Nagase Otoshi'. Needs akurasu check.

rows.en: You dare defy Gyandlar?!
Feel the power of a Gyandlar Commander!
I'll slit your throat!
Hah hah! Say your prayers!
I'll show you what happens to those who cross Gyandlar!
C'mon, c'mon! Dance, daaance!
This is how Gyandlar does things!
You dare defy Lord Gades?!
I'll beat you to death!
That Commander Ranking is mine!
uncertain: Shared grunt set (Kyasumodon/Zarios/Falgos): 'Commander Ranking' used as short form of glossary 'Gyandlar Commander ranking'.

rows.en: Hyahahahaha! What's wrong, what's wrong?!
Tenku Chushin Ken, my ass!
What's so great about Rom Stol?!
Wh-what's so great about Tenku Chushin Ken anyway?!
I've got orders to kill you!
Time to rack up my Commander Ranking!
Lord Gades is angry, y'know!
Don't you dare defy Gyandlar!
If it weren't for you lot...!
Hyahhaa! Payback time!
Watch your mouth!
Interesting! I'll take you on!
Damn you!
How dare a little brat like you!
You startled me! Take this!
Die and make amends!
Like hell I'll go down!
GYAAAAAAH!
L-Lady Diondraaaaa!
F-forgive meeeee!
L-L-L-Lord Gadeeeees!
I'll curse you all! Curse... GYAAAH!
Long live Lord Gadeeeees!
Who the hell are you?!
GUOOOOH!
G-give the retreat order!
rows.notes: Grunt asking for a retreat order; read as an appeal to command.
uncertain: Literal is 'R-retreat order...!'; could also be read as calling for a retreat. Rendered as a plea for the order.

rows.en: I-I don't wanna die!
It's hopeleeeess!
Gyaaah, I'm gonna diiiie!
H-help meeee!
I'll never do anything bad again!
S-stop iiiit!
No picking on the weeeak!
Damn you, quit darting around!
You're not good enough yet!
What an irritating bunch!
Hey, what's up?! That all you got?!
I'll show you a Gyandlar Commander's pride!
At this rate my Commander Ranking won't go up!
Ow! But it ain't working!
Gwah! Life's rough for a bottom-rung Commander...
These guys... they're strong! That's not what I was told!
Lady Diondra! This is lookin' real bad!
Gahahahahaha! Didn't hurt one bit!
Don't mess with the space crime syndicate Gyandlar!
Did a mosquito bite me? Ahahahaha!
As if that'd work on us Gyandlar Commanders!
That's nothin'!
Lame! You're way too lame!
Don't lump a Gyandlar Commander in with the riffraff!
Ahh, that itches, that itches!
What a joke. Is this all you've got?
Tch, what a lame-ass attack!
Ahh, you're so slow it makes me yawn!
Get in closer! You coward!
You're hopeless!
Look at the state of you!
Like a little spank on the butt, huh? Gyahahaha
uncertain: Butt-spank taunt (oshiri penpen); glossary 'Pen Pen' (Eva penguin) does not apply here.

rows.en: That's the power of a Gyandlar Commander!
Didn't work! Gyahahaha!
Like that's gonna break my Barrier!
I'm out of ammo?!
I'm out of gas, dammit!
Bastard! Makin' a fool of me!
Get over here where I can reach ya!
Where'd you come from?!
Keep pullin' crap like that and I'll beat you senseless!
Backup! I'm backin' you up!
rows.notes: Support-attack line.

rows.en: Yahoo! Eat this too!
You'll regret makin' an enemy of the Commanders!
Just die already!
Hyahahaha! I can't stop laughing!
I told ya, I ain't lettin' you!
I'm gonna be the shield, I said!
rows.notes: Support-defend line.

rows.en: If I don't, the boss lady'll chew me out!
rows.notes: Anego = Diondra; rendered 'the boss lady'.

rows.en: Feast your eyes! A Gyandlar Commander's true grit!
Quit makin' work for me!
You bastard! I'll knock you flat!
C'mon, c'mon! Dance, dance!
Here I go!
I'll crush you! Hyahhaa!
Eat this, you dumbass!!
Go to helllll!!
I'll send ya to the afterlife!
I'll finish this in one go!
Here's a direct hit! Die and rot!
I'll make you cry, punk!
You're the first one I'm makin' cry!
Triple Commander Ranking points! They're mine!
You'd defy Gyandlar?! You idiot!
I'll show you a Commander's true strength!
Heh heh heh heh, hey sweetie, how about some tea?
Hyahaha! You're Rom's little sister?! Dibs!!
rows.notes: Aimed at Leina (Rom's younger sister).

rows.en: At last I've got you! Prepare yourself, Rom Stol!
I'm sick of your face, Rom!
It's you lot! Always, always, always gettin' in my way!
Pile of junk! Croak already!!
I ain't beaten yeeeet!
That's payback, I'm tellin' ya!
Don't get full of yourseeeelf!
Hey, you've got guts! Step outside!
You're standin' up to me? Huh?! Oi!
Guess you've gotta die now, pal. Yep, it's the only way!
I won't just take this lying down!
This is what they call... a counterattack, huh?!
rows.notes: Parody of a famous baseball-commentary verbal tic; rendered as hesitant phrasing.

rows.en: Long live Gyandlaaaar!
I-I'll come back to haunt youuu!!
Remember this! Huh? You'll forget?!
Lady Diondraaa! I blew iiiit!
I'll be back! Don't you forget it!!
My C-Commander Ranking... so much for raising it...
I-I'll curse you! Curse... GYAAAH!!
This is way beyond worryin' about rankings!
At this rate, I'm gonna get killed!
Eeek! I'm gonna diiie!
Wh-wh-wh-what do I dooo?!
That was nasty! What kind of hero does that?!
uncertain: Seigi no mikata can be singular or plural; used 'What kind of hero does that?!' to stay neutral.

rows.en: I-I'm losin'?! No way, I'm gonna lose!
It's no goood! There's nothin' I can doooo!
I'm cornered?! Hyaaah!
Lord Gades! Heeelp!
Lady Diondra! Heeelp!
I-I-I'm Gyandlar, y'know! I'm scary, y'knooow!
No, I'm dead! I'm totally dead! Aaah!
I won't do bad stuff anymore! Okay?! Okay?!
Tenku Whatsit Fist really hurts this bad?!
rows.notes: The grunt mangles the style name; kept the mangling.

rows.en: Is this Rom goin' all out?! Don't go all out!
Guess we really can't beat these guys!
Gwaah! How many times am I gonna get beat by these guys?!
C'mon, we go way back! Let me off!
Damn! Took that one full on!
Tch, you're better than I thought!
Owww, that hurt more than I thought!
Ugyaaah!
Y-you've gotta be kiddin' me, you bastard!
Y-you! Are you even human?!
I-I just remembered somethin'! I'm goin' home!!
What the hell was that?! You bastard!!
Tch, things are startin' to look dicey!
Grr! Playtime's over!!
Damn it all, I've had it with this!!
D-don't think this is all I've got!
Owww! You bitch! You're makin' a fool of me!
rows.notes: Insult aimed at a female pilot; kept full strength.

rows.en: What kind of power is that for a woman?!
N-not bad, Rom Stol!
You! Rom! Don't you get cocky!
My ranking's gonna drop at this rate!
Those guys... doin' whatever they like, as usual!
That ain't even a scratch!
Pfft, you're nothin' special, are ya?
Ahh, that itches, that itches
Whoa!! What the heck is that?
What, you're done already?
Put a little more fight into it. Okay?
Get outta my way! You lousy loser!
Seriously? That attack? Seriously?
Bo-ring. This attack is waaay too boring
rows.notes: Darui = tedious/sluggish; rendered 'boring'.

rows.en: Th-they got meee!! ...Just kiddin'
Well... I guess you'd call this minor damage
Tch, you annoying pest!
Now, now, that's naughty, little missy!
What a cuuute little attack that was!
Your Whatchamacallit Fist ain't workin'!
Kenro, my ass! That's weak!
Champions of justice ain't so tough after all!
Hyahaha! Is Gyandlar winnin' this time?!
I'll dodge with our superior mobility! ...or somethin'?!
rows.notes: Parody of a mecha-anime evasion line.

rows.en: I can see it...! Just kiddin', hyahhaa!!
rows.notes: Parody of the Newtype 'I can see it' line.

rows.en: You just can't hit me, see!
You! Very bad shooter, yes!
uncertain: Mock broken English in katakana (you, heta-kuso ne = you are bad at it); rendered as broken English without caricature.

rows.en: Standin' up to the guy standin' guard?! Gahaha!!
uncertain: Pun on tate (shield) and tatetsuku (defy); replaced with an English wordplay on 'standing'.

rows.en: Lucky! Ducky! Chuckie-wucky!!
uncertain: Nonsense rhyme (lucky, cookie, haguki/gums); replaced with an English nonsense rhyme.

rows.en: Well, uh... that's just how it is!
Whoa there! Lucky!
How's that? Didn't see that comin', huh?!
Turns out I had a Barrier, see!
Hey, hey! Nyah nyah, spank my butt!!
Well, see ya later, Jammer-gator!
uncertain: Pun on 'honja ma(ta)' (see you) and Jammer; rendered 'see ya later, Jammer-gator'.

rows.en: Get lost, I'm tellin' ya!
Yahoooooo!
Hyahahaha! I'm amazin'!
Whoa?! I didn't know I had THIS kind of skill!
Geh?! I can't counterattack!
I've got no strength left! Resupply, resupply!!
No waaay! There's nothin' I can do?!
Huh?! Where'd you vanish to?!
You bastard! Let me counterattack!!
Where'd you circle around to?!
Okay, I'll back you up! ...Just kiddin', hyahhaa!
I'll lend a hand, so you're buyin' me a drink later!!
There! You're wide open all over the place!
uncertain: Pun on the stock phrase 'kekkou kedarake'; pun dropped, kept the 'wide open' meaning.

rows.en: Heh heh heh, yours truly'll lend a hand too, boss!
rows.notes: Uses the humble lackey pronoun 'asshi'; rendered 'yours truly ... boss'.

rows.en: This favor's gonna cost ya big!!
Be grateful, deeper than the sea!!
rows.notes: Mangled idiom (deeper than the sea); kept the oddness.

rows.en: Don't you go stealin' my spotlight!!
Whoa there! Commander Ranking, uuup!
Let's beat 'em to a pulp!
Let's gang up on 'em! Here we goooo!!
Let's beat 'em black and blue! Get 'em!!
Okay, okay. I'm chargin' in!
I know! Die!!
uncertain: Partner-attack reply; the grunt answers 'I know!' to an unseen partner. Kept as is.

rows.en: Oh! Attackin' with the new system, huh?!
rows.notes: Likely the combination/team attack line.

rows.en: Come on! Once I'm up close, you're mine!
Go on, run around! Run!
It ain't much, but here, take it!
rows.notes: Parody of the polite gift formula.

rows.en: If you're lucky, it might miss!!
Dance, dance! DANCE, I said!!
This is gonna hurt if it hits!!
You're in range! Dum-my!
